projects.title: AnomAI — AWS IAM Anomaly Detection & Incident Explanation
projects.description: Leading a capstone team building an AWS pipeline that detects IAM-focused anomalies and presents them in a SIEM-style dashboard with an incident Q&A chatbot for non-experts.
highlights: IAM anomaly detection pipeline from raw events → structured signals
SIEM-style dashboard for clear visibility and triage
Incident Q&A chatbot that translates findings for non-experts

projects.title: Incident Response Automation with AWS Config and Lambda
projects.description: Built an automated remediation workflow that detects unauthorized Security Group changes using AWS Config and immediately restores approved rules with Lambda.
highlights: Detects drift in Security Group rules via AWS Config
Auto-remediates to approved configuration using Lambda
Reduces exposure time for insecure network changes

projects.title: Monitoring & Alerting with AWS CloudTrail
projects.description: Created an event-driven monitoring pipeline that analyzes CloudTrail logs to detect failed authentication and sensitive configuration changes without external SIEM tools.
highlights: Event-driven alerts for failed auth and sensitive changes
Built-in visibility using native AWS monitoring patterns
Improves awareness and response speed without extra tooling
